recent: a quiet lakeside floating sauna landing in warm late-afternoon light, the floor entirely above water — after swimming she sits to let the sun dry her shoulders and lifts a folded warm blanket off her lap to welcome the breeze; lifting the blanket reveals her fully covered swimsuit and legs

an indoor roller rink during a quiet afternoon with a low cushioned bench beside the rail — she pauses after her first circuit, grinning at the wobbling reflection of her colored wheels on the polished floor

a sunny private conservatory breakfast nook with a hammock chair and an orange tree — she laughs quietly as the hammock chair tilts under her and the loose decorative apron panel slides off her knees; she catches the panel while her opaque lingerie stays securely in place

an open-air hillside cable-car stop at clear midday, a little picnic bench beside the lavender glass cabin — she splits a round sweet bun for a pair of tiny sparrows that have unexpectedly approached her lunch; the magnetic sovereign enjoys being approached without her power
a resort cabana with a shaded daybed by the water — dries her hair with a towel
her own room in a house of her element's kingdom — standing
a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — brings a cup to her lips
overgrown jungle temple ruins — carries a small ceramic pellet glowing red-hot by its own heat inside a thick clear capsule low at her side
the crest walkway of a hydroelectric dam — standing
